svg.title: Two parallel tubes under flux reinforcement
svg.desc: Conductivity against time for a short and a long tube between one source and one sink, for mu = 0.6, 1 and 1.5.
svg.text: Two parallel tubes, lengths 1 and 1.5, total flow 1: dD/dt = Q^mu - D
The exponent decides whether the network keeps redundancy (mu < 1), finds the shortest route (mu = 1), or commits early (mu > 1).
mu = 1: only the short tube survives
mu = 1.5, equal start: the short tube wins
mu = 1.5, long tube favoured at the start: it wins
